answer.justification: Every logit-level value is exactly at the identity point. Top-1 agreement and sequence agreement are both 1.000, and KL, TV and the Token-DiFR gap are all 0.000. The raw-score shift ÷ TV is undefined (0 ÷ 0), which happens only when the model is the reference itself. Every other class would show non-zero logit differences. The smallest is quantization, with KL about 0.05, TV about 0.05 and top-1 agreement about 0.95. Even a single draw of 64 prompts would not plausibly push those values all the way to zero. Output and activation levels were not measured, but the logit evidence alone fits only the none class.
